name: Barbell front squat
cues: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high
Keep your torso tall as you descend
Knees track over your toes
Stand up by driving through mid foot

name: Barbell Zercher squat
cues: Hook the bar in the crease of your elbows
Keep your chest up and ribs down
Sit between your hips and stand tall
Wrap the bar with a pad if it bites

name: Barbell walking lunge
cues: Set the bar on your upper back and brace
Take a long step and lower your back knee
Keep your front foot flat
Push through the front heel into the next step

name: Barbell reverse lunge
cues: Brace and step straight back
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel
Keep your weight on the front foot
Push the floor away to return

name: Barbell Bulgarian split squat
cues: Rest your back foot on a bench behind you
Step far enough forward to keep your front shin upright
Lower straight down between your feet
Drive through your front foot to stand

name: Barbell step-up
cues: Place your whole front foot on the box
Drive through the front heel to stand tall
Lower under control without bouncing off the floor
Keep your hips level as you step

name: Barbell hip thrust
cues: Rest your upper back on the bench edge
Pad the bar and roll it over your hips
Tuck your chin and keep your shins vertical at the top
Squeeze your glutes to lock out without arching your lower back

name: Barbell glute bridge
cues: Lie on the floor with the bar over your hips
Feet flat, shins near vertical at the top
Press your hips up and pause
Lower slowly until the plates touch down

name: Barbell good morning
cues: Bar sits low on your back, soft knees
Push your hips back with a flat back
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch
Drive your hips forward to stand

name: Sumo deadlift
cues: Wide stance, toes turned out, hands inside your knees
Spread the floor with your feet as you pull
Keep your chest up and the bar against your legs
Finish by squeezing your glutes

name: Barbell rack pull
cues: Set the bar at or just below knee height
Pull the slack out before you lift
Drive your hips through to stand tall
Lower the bar back to the pins under control

name: Barbell bent-over row
cues: Hinge until your torso is near parallel with the floor
Hold your back flat for the whole set
Pull the bar to your lower ribs
Lower until your arms are straight

name: Reverse-grip barbell row
cues: Hold the bar underhand about shoulder width
Hinge to a steep torso angle and keep it fixed
Pull the bar toward your lower stomach
Keep your elbows close to your sides

name: Pendlay row
cues: Torso parallel to the floor and the bar on the ground each rep
Brace before you pull
Row the bar to your lower chest in one fast pull
Reset on the floor between reps

name: T-bar row
cues: Stand over the bar and hinge with a flat back
Pull the handle toward your chest
Keep your hips still
Lower until your arms are straight

name: Barbell shrug
cues: Hold the bar at arm length in front of your thighs
Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears
Pause briefly at the top
Lower without letting the bar swing

name: Barbell upright row
cues: Use a grip about shoulder width or wider
Lead with your elbows and keep the bar close
Stop at about chest height
Lower slowly without leaning back

name: Incline barbell bench press
cues: Set the bench to a low to medium incline
Shoulder blades pinched and down
Lower the bar to your upper chest
Press back over your shoulders

name: Decline barbell bench press
cues: Hook your legs in and lie back on the decline bench
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows
Press up and slightly back

name: Close-grip bench press
cues: Hands about shoulder width, not narrower
Tuck your elbows toward your sides
Lower the bar to your lower chest
Press until your elbows lock out

name: Barbell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor inside a rack with the bar set just below lockout height
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor
Pause without relaxing
Press back to full lockout

name: Barbell push press
cues: Bar on your front shoulders, ribs down
Dip a few inches and drive up with your legs
Press the bar overhead as your legs finish
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot

name: Landmine press
cues: Hold the end of the bar at your shoulder
Stand with a split stance and brace
Press up and forward along the arc of the bar
Lower back to your shoulder under control

name: Barbell curl
cues: Stand tall with your elbows at your sides
Curl the bar without swinging your hips
Squeeze at the top
Lower to full arm length

name: EZ bar curl
cues: Grip the angled sections of the bar
Keep your elbows pinned beside you
Curl up without leaning back
Lower slowly to straight arms

name: EZ bar preacher curl
cues: Set the pad under your armpits
Lower the bar until your arms are nearly straight
Curl up without lifting your elbows off the pad
Control the way down

name: EZ bar skull crusher
cues: Lie on a bench with the bar over your chest
Keep your upper arms still
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead
Extend back to the start

name: Reverse barbell curl
cues: Hold the bar overhand about shoulder width
Keep your wrists straight
Curl up with your elbows at your sides
Use a lighter bar than you would for a regular curl

name: Barbell wrist curl
cues: Rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench with wrists past the edge
Let the bar roll to your fingertips
Curl the bar up with your wrists only
Choose a load you can control through the full range

name: Barbell standing calf raise
cues: Bar on your upper back, balls of your feet on a plate or step
Rise as high as you can
Pause at the top
Lower to a full stretch

name: Trap bar deadlift
cues: Stand in the middle of the bar and grip the handles
Brace and push the floor away
Keep the bar close and your chest up
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes

name: Trap bar shrug
cues: Stand inside the bar with arms straight
Lift your shoulders straight up
Pause at the top
Lower without letting your arms bend

name: Barbell rollout
cues: Kneel and grip the bar with plates on both ends
Brace your trunk and posteriorly tilt your pelvis
Roll out only as far as you can keep your back flat
Pull back using your abs, not your hips

name: Barbell side bend
cues: Hold the bar across your upper back
Bend sideways without twisting
Return to upright with your side muscles
Keep the load light and the motion smooth

name: Barbell power clean
cues: Set up like a deadlift with the bar over mid foot
Pull to your thighs then extend your hips fast
Shrug and pull yourself under the bar
Catch it on your front shoulders with elbows forward
